# tilgangsportalen_terms_of_use_role_assignment (Resource)

Manages Terms of Use assignments for System Roles in Tilgangsportalen.

This resource creates and manages the association between a System Role and Terms of Use object. When users are granted access to a role with Terms of Use, they must accept the terms before gaining access.

**Important Notes:**

- Only one Terms of Use can be assigned to a role at a time.

- Assigning new Terms of Use will replace any existing assignment.

- If the referenced System Role is deleted, this assignment will be automatically removed from state.

- Changes to `role_name` will force recreation of the assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tilgangsportalen_system_role" "example" {
  name              = "published-role-name"
  product_category  = "TBD"    # product category of the system role. Must match an avaialable category
  system_role_owner = "m00001" # identity of the user who is the owner of the system role
  approval_level    = "L2"     # approval level of the system role
  description       = "Role for giving access to group_1 assigned resources."
  it_shop_name      = "General access shop shelf" # Optional. Defaults to "General access shop shelf"
}

resource "tilgangsportalen_terms_of_use_role_assignment" "example" {
  role_name               = tilgangsportalen_system_role.example.name
  terms_of_use_identifier = "terms of use identifier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_name` (String) The name of the System Role to assign Terms of Use to. This must be an existing System Role in Tilgangsportalen. Changing this value will force creation of a new resource.
- `terms_of_use_identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the Terms of Use object to assign to the role. This identifier references a Terms of Use object that exists in Tilgangsportalen. Changing this value will update the assignment to use the new Terms of Use object, replacing any previously assigned terms. Only one Terms of Use can be assigned to a role at a time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this Terms of Use assignment formatted as `RoleName|TermsOfUseIdentifier`
- `terms_of_use_description` (String) The human-readable description of the assigned Terms of Use object. This field is automatically populated from Tilgangsportalen.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import tilgangsportalen_terms_of_use_role_assignment.example "published-role-name|terms of use identifier"
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import the resource. For example:

```terraform
import {
  id = "published-role-name|terms of use identifier"
  to = tilgangsportalen_terms_of_use_role_assignment.example
}
```
